text: My iPhone order #112233 hasn't arrived yet in Mumbai, it's been 6 days!
We're sorry to hear that. Can you confirm your order ID so we can check?
Yes it's 112233
Thanks! Your package was delayed due to a courier issue, it will arrive by tomorrow.
Ok thank you, please keep me updated
I can't log into my Apple ID, OTP is not coming to my phone
Sorry for the trouble! Can you confirm the phone number linked to your Apple ID?
It's linked to my old number, I don't have access anymore
No worries, please visit iforgot.apple.com to reset your account recovery options.
That worked, thanks so much!
My Uber payment of $45 failed but the amount got deducted from my card!
That's frustrating, we apologize. Can you share your trip ID?
Trip ID is UB-88291
We've confirmed the duplicate charge and processed a refund of $45, it should reflect in 3-5 business days.
Great, thank you for the quick refund!
I want to cancel my order #559911 for the Samsung TV, placed yesterday.
We can help with that. Please note the order has already shipped from our Bangalore warehouse.
That's really annoying, I needed this cancelled before shipping!
I understand your frustration. You can refuse the delivery and we'll process a full refund once it's returned.
Fine, I'll do that.
My MacBook Pro keeps crashing after the latest macOS update.
Sorry to hear that! Have you tried restarting in Safe Mode?
Yes, still crashing constantly, this is so frustrating.
Please DM us your device serial number so we can escalate this to our engineering team.
Sent, hope this gets fixed soon.
Can't access my Uber Eats account, says account suspended for no reason.
Sorry about that! We've reviewed your account and lifted the suspension, please try logging in again.
It's working now, thank you so much for the fast help!
